Data
changes.oldHtml: Data

changes.oldText: The Data page lists the storage folders (vfolders) owned by the currently selected project. Use this page to create project-shared folders, restore folders that were accidentally deleted, or purge folders that no longer need to be retained.
changes.oldHtml: The Data page lists the storage folders (vfolders) owned by the currently selected project. Use this page to create project-shared folders, restore folders that were accidentally deleted, or purge folders that no longer need to be retained.

changes.oldText: ./images/project_admin_data_page.png
The page provides the following controls:
changes.oldHtml: The page provides the following controls:

changes.oldText: Active / Trash tabs: Switch between currently active folders and folders that have been soft-deleted. Each tab shows a count badge with the number of folders it contains.
changes.oldHtml: Active / Trash tabs: Switch between currently active folders and folders that have been soft-deleted. Each tab shows a count badge with the number of folders it contains.

changes.oldText: Mode pill: Filter by folder usage mode — All, General, Pipeline, Auto Mount, or Models. The Pipeline and Models options appear only when the corresponding features are enabled in the deployment — the FastTrack pipeline endpoint for Pipeline, and model folders for Models.
changes.oldHtml:
Mode pill: Filter by folder usage mode — All, General, Pipeline, Auto Mount, or Models.

The Pipeline and Models options appear only when the corresponding features are enabled in the deployment — the FastTrack pipeline endpoint for Pipeline, and model folders for Models.

changes.oldText: Property filter: Filter the list using the standard storage-folder property filter.
changes.oldHtml: Property filter: Filter the list using the standard storage-folder property filter.

changes.oldText: Use a folder's Edit labels action to attach key-value labels to it, or select several folders and click Add labels to label them in bulk.
